claims: The Artemis II crew splashed down safely in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. ET.
The Artemis II crew returned to Earth after a 10-day mission.
The Orion spacecraft landed safely in the water.
The Artemis II landing occurred on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II landing location was the Pacific Ocean near San Diego.
The Artemis II mission duration was approximately 10 days.
The Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
Artemis II was a crewed lunar flyby.
Artemis II involved no lunar landing.
Artemis II tested systems for future landings.
Following the splashdown, the Artemis II crew was extracted by NASA and U.S. Navy personnel for transport back to land.
